item.text: The regression test exposed a coupling in the existing `ops` workaround: adding `treasury` also made it retry short pages at twice the limit, which the report does not require and the feed does not support. I’m separating “follow the cursor” from “retry a short page” so treasury continues at the normal page size.

Fixed `treasury` pagination so it follows a next cursor after a short page, continuing at the normal page size. Added a regression test for the reported page shape in [test_client.py](C:/Users/lauti_lvk88nb/AppData/Local/Temp/cdb-b-page-cursor-true_authority-4-gvcd5eg2/ws/tests/test_client.py).
